sourceRule: The 2022 restriction replaces the old year-10 program with the current year-9 contents. Canonical J10 is not official Bremen time authority. Explicitly reviewed current geometry/counting applications are acquired in year 9; remaining old J10 functions are editorial upper-secondary entry preparation, subject to actual earlier prerequisite demand. Source target membership and reference roles remain unchanged.

decisionRationales.upper_no_current_J9_time_authority_for_f: 2022 J9 functions are linear/quadratic. Geometric Sin/Cos/Tan does not establish periodic functions, radians or calculus; superseded 2006 J10 overview rows do not establish J9.
decisionRationales.J9_source_backed_counting_or_tree_method: 2022 annex pp1-2 counting/tree methods and retained 2006 J8 p20 multi-stage experiments/path rules.
decisionRationales.J9_source_backed_geometry_or_own_matchin: 2022 annex p1 geometry plus p2 explicit retention of 2006 geometry standards p23. Matching own tasks retain their actual coverage.
decisionRationales.J9_possible_reviewed_geometry_method_not: A Cavalieri plausibility argument uses only the retained prism-volume skill; the primary source does not name Cavalieri. Preserve this distinction in placement evidence.
decisionRationales.upper_editorial_until_full_task_scope_is: Full own task also includes substitution; the annex alone proves radical/quadratic contents, not every unrestricted substitution task.
decisionRationales.J9_reviewed_simulation_application_not_o: 2006 J8 p20 expressly permits stochastic simulations and is not replaced by the 2022 J9 restriction. Monte Carlo is an own operationalization; do not claim that name is mandatory.
